name: yumi-remotion
description: Remotion assets for the Yumi cat: the layered character, its moods, and demo-video scenes.

scripts.stills: remotion still YumiIntro out/intro.png --frame=150 && remotion still YumiMoods out/moods.png --frame=40 && remotion still YumiIdleLoop out/idle.png --frame=10
scripts.render:all: npm run render:intro && npm run render:moods && npm run render:idle && npm run render:sticker
